2301:206.name: Table Cell Value
2301:206.description:
Description
A flexible set of content patterns for table cells, including text, media, selection controls, status, links, badges, actions, products, and custom slot content.


When to use
Use within Table Body Cell to represent the semantic type of data or control required by a column.


Usage guidelines
Select the Type variant based on meaning, not visual preference.
Keep repeated cells in a column consistent.
Use interactive variants only when the table supports that action.
Keep labels brief and provide accessible names for icon-only actions.
Use Slot only when none of the standard variants fit.


Properties
Type — Selects the cell-value pattern.
Value — Sets the primary displayed text where supported.
Show Affiliate, Show Komlabs, Show Raja Ongkir, Show Komads, Show Komcards, Show Komchat, Show Komclass, Show Kompack, Show Komplace, Show Komship, Show Komtim, Show Komed, Show Komstore, Show Komerce — Controls product marks in the Product variant.
Show Edit, Show Delete, Show More — Controls visible actions in Action (Icon).
Slot — Replaces the custom content in the Slot variant.

2301:191.name: Type=Text
2301:191.description:
Description
Displays a single plain-text value.


When to use
Use for names, dates, identifiers, categories, and other short values that need no additional visual treatment.


Usage guidelines
Keep values concise and use consistent formatting within the column.
Align numeric content according to the table's numeric-column convention.


Properties
Value — Sets the displayed text.

2301:193.name: Type=Image Text
2301:193.description:
Description
Displays a thumbnail or avatar alongside a primary text value.


When to use
Use when a record benefits from visual identification, such as a person, product, or organization.


Usage guidelines
Use consistent image dimensions and crop behavior across the column.
Keep the text label short and meaningful.
Do not rely on the image alone to communicate identity.


Properties
Value — Sets the text displayed beside the image.
Image content — Override the nested image or avatar in the instance.

2301:196.name: Type=Image
2301:196.description:
Description
Displays image-only content within a table cell.


When to use
Use for compact visual previews when a text label is unnecessary or appears in another column.


Usage guidelines
Use a consistent aspect ratio and crop across rows.
Provide adjacent text or accessible context when the image carries important meaning.


Properties
Image content — Override the nested image in the instance.

2301:198.name: Type=Action
2301:198.description:
Description
Displays a compact text action for a row-level task.


When to use
Use for one clear, high-priority action associated with the row.


Usage guidelines
Use a short verb-led label.
Avoid placing multiple competing primary actions in the same cell.
Use Action (Icon) when several compact actions are required.


Properties
Value — Sets the action label.

2266:1143.name: Roundness=Default, Style=Primary, Size=Small, State=Default
2266:1143.description:
This variant is a high-emphasis filled button for the most important action in a view, sized for dense layouts, toolbars, tables, or inline actions, uses the standard corner treatment, and represents the resting, interactive state.

WHEN TO USE
• Use for the main call to action or the preferred next step.
• Use when space is limited while maintaining a usable target.
• Use for the default product interface treatment.
• Use when the button is available and ready for interaction.

USAGE GUIDELINES
• Limit Primary buttons to one per section or decision point.
• Do not use Small merely to fit an overly long label.
• Keep the same corner treatment across buttons in one action group.
• Use Default as the resting representation in layouts and documentation.
• Use a concise, action-oriented label and include icons only when they improve comprehension.

PROPERTIES
• Style — Primary
• Size — Small
• Roundness — Default
• State — Default
• Label — Editable button text.
• Show Label — Toggles the text label.
• Show left icon / Show right icon — Toggles leading and trailing icons.
• Left icon / Right icon — Swaps the corresponding icon.

2301:203.name: Type=Badge
2301:203.description:
Description
Displays a compact badge for categorical or descriptive metadata.


When to use
Use for short categories, labels, tags, or non-interactive attributes.


Usage guidelines
Keep labels brief.
Use the same badge treatment for the same meaning across the table.
Do not use a badge as a button.


Properties
Value — Sets the badge label.

2841:130.name: Variant=primary
2841:130.description:
The default high-emphasis badge for general labels and key categories.


When to useUse when a label needs clear prominence but does not represent a success, warning, error, or informational state.


Usage guidelinesReserve for the most important neutral label in a group.
Prefer a semantic variant when the label communicates status.


PropertiesVariant: primary
Label: Editable badge text.

2574:742.name: Type=Stacked Text
2574:742.description:
Description
Displays a primary value with supporting secondary text below it.


When to use
Use when a cell needs a clear main value plus brief supporting context, such as a name and role.


Usage guidelines
Keep the primary line concise.
Use secondary text only for helpful context.
Maintain the same hierarchy across the column.


Properties
Value — Sets the primary text.
Secondary text — Override the nested supporting text in the instance.

2574:745.name: Type=Link
2574:745.description:
Description
Displays a text value styled as a link.


When to use
Use when selecting the value navigates to related content or opens a relevant destination.


Usage guidelines
Use descriptive link text.
Reserve link styling for navigational actions.
Keep behavior consistent across the column.


Properties
Value — Sets the link label.

2856:152.name: Button/Default/Link/Small/Default
2856:152.description:
This variant is a button styled as inline text with link-like visual treatment, sized for dense layouts, toolbars, tables, or inline actions, uses the standard corner treatment, and represents the resting, interactive state.

WHEN TO USE
• Use for a low-emphasis action that must behave like a button while visually aligning with surrounding text.
• Use when space is limited while maintaining a usable target.
• Use for the default product interface treatment.
• Use when the button is available and ready for interaction.

USAGE GUIDELINES
• Use a true Link component for navigation and keep the distinction between actions and destinations clear.
• Do not use Small merely to fit an overly long label.
• Keep the same corner treatment across buttons in one action group.
• Use Default as the resting representation in layouts and documentation.
• Use a concise, action-oriented label and include icons only when they improve comprehension.

PROPERTIES
• Style — Link
• Size — Small
• Roundness — Default
• State — Default
• Label — Editable button text.
• Show Label — Toggles the text label.
• Show left icon / Show right icon — Toggles leading and trailing icons.
• Left icon / Right icon — Swaps the corresponding icon.

2574:747.name: Type=Checkbox
2574:747.description:
Description
Displays a checkbox control inside a table cell.


When to use
Use for row selection or a boolean field that is intentionally editable in the table.


Usage guidelines
Use the header checkbox for select-all behavior when appropriate.
Clearly distinguish selectable rows from read-only data.
Keep selection behavior consistent across the table.


Properties
Checkbox state — Configure the nested checkbox instance.

2179:467.name: State=off, Size=Medium, Disabled=false
2179:467.description: Interactive, unselected checkbox in the Medium size. Use when users can select an available independent option.

2574:753.name: Type=Toggle
2574:753.description:
Description
Displays a toggle control for a binary setting.


When to use
Use when users can enable or disable a row-level setting directly in the table.


Usage guidelines
Apply changes immediately or clearly communicate when saving is required.
Do not use for row selection.
Ensure the setting has an unambiguous column label.


Properties
Toggle state — Configure the nested toggle instance.

2266:4818.name: State=Off, Disabled=False, Size=Small
2266:4818.description:
Description
A Small switch in the Off state that is interactive.

When to use
Use when the setting is inactive and users may change it immediately.

Usage guidelines
Use in compact or information-dense layouts.
Pair the switch with a label that describes the setting.
Keep the on-state meaning positive and unambiguous.
Apply the state change immediately and preserve clear interaction feedback.
Use one label position unless the product requirement explicitly calls for both.

Properties
State: Off
Disabled: False
Size: Small
leftLabel: Optional boolean property inherited from the component set.
rightLabel: Optional boolean property inherited from the component set.

2574:761.name: Type=Avatar Text
2574:761.description:
Description
Displays an avatar with an accompanying text value.


When to use
Use for people, teams, organizations, or other entities where identity benefits from an avatar.


Usage guidelines
Use consistent avatar sizes.
Always include a text label; do not rely on the avatar alone.
Use initials or a fallback image when artwork is unavailable.


Properties
Value — Sets the text beside the avatar.
Avatar content — Override the nested avatar in the instance.

2843:93.name: size=mini, type=image
2843:93.description:
Description
Mini image avatar (24px). Displays a profile image as the primary identity treatment.


When to use
Use this variant for dense lists, inline mentions, compact controls, or tightly constrained layouts when a clear and recognizable profile image is available.


Usage guidelines
Use only when space is limited and identity is supported by nearby text.
Keep the crop centered and ensure the subject remains legible at this size.
Pair with a visible name or accessible label when the surrounding context does not identify the user.


Properties
size: mini (24px, fixed by this variant)
type: image (fixed by this variant)
Set showStatus based on whether live presence is relevant.

2574:764.name: Type=Status
2574:764.description:
Description
Displays a status indicator with a text label.


When to use
Use for operational states such as active, pending, completed, or unavailable.


Usage guidelines
Pair color with text so status is not communicated by color alone.
Use consistent labels and colors for the same status.
Keep the status vocabulary small and clear.


Properties
Value — Sets the status label.

2574:767.name: Type=Number
2574:767.description:
Description
Displays a numeric value in a table cell.


When to use
Use for quantities, prices, percentages, counts, and other comparable numeric data.


Usage guidelines
Use consistent units, separators, and decimal precision within the column.
Align numbers consistently to support scanning and comparison.
Include currency or percentage symbols where needed.


Properties
Value — Sets the displayed number or formatted numeric string.

2929:20629.name: Type=Action (Icon)
2929:20629.description:
Description
Displays a compact group of icon-only row actions.


When to use
Use when a row needs multiple common actions and space is limited.


Usage guidelines
Show only actions that are available for the row.
Keep action order consistent across all rows.
Provide clear tooltips and accessible labels for every icon.
Use destructive actions carefully and require confirmation when appropriate.


Properties
Show Edit — Shows or hides the edit action.
Show Delete — Shows or hides the delete action.
Show More — Shows or hides the overflow action.

2266:1183.name: Roundness=Default, Style=Secondary, Size=Small, State=Default
2266:1183.description:
This variant is a medium-emphasis filled button for an action that supports the primary action, sized for dense layouts, toolbars, tables, or inline actions, uses the standard corner treatment, and represents the resting, interactive state.

WHEN TO USE
• Use for alternate actions that should remain visible without competing with Primary.
• Use when space is limited while maintaining a usable target.
• Use for the default product interface treatment.
• Use when the button is available and ready for interaction.

USAGE GUIDELINES
• Pair with Primary when users need a clear secondary choice.
• Do not use Small merely to fit an overly long label.
• Keep the same corner treatment across buttons in one action group.
• Use Default as the resting representation in layouts and documentation.
• Use a concise, action-oriented label and include icons only when they improve comprehension.

PROPERTIES
• Style — Secondary
• Size — Small
• Roundness — Default
• State — Default
• Label — Editable button text.
• Show Label — Toggles the text label.
• Show left icon / Show right icon — Toggles leading and trailing icons.
• Left icon / Right icon — Swaps the corresponding icon.

2266:1343.name: Roundness=Default, Style=Destructive, Size=Small, State=Default
2266:1343.description:
This variant is a high-emphasis button that communicates a dangerous or irreversible action, sized for dense layouts, toolbars, tables, or inline actions, uses the standard corner treatment, and represents the resting, interactive state.

WHEN TO USE
• Use for actions such as delete, remove, revoke, or permanently discard.
• Use when space is limited while maintaining a usable target.
• Use for the default product interface treatment.
• Use when the button is available and ready for interaction.

USAGE GUIDELINES
• Use an explicit label and add confirmation when the outcome is difficult to reverse.
• Do not use Small merely to fit an overly long label.
• Keep the same corner treatment across buttons in one action group.
• Use Default as the resting representation in layouts and documentation.
• Use a concise, action-oriented label and include icons only when they improve comprehension.

PROPERTIES
• Style — Destructive
• Size — Small
• Roundness — Default
• State — Default
• Label — Editable button text.
• Show Label — Toggles the text label.
• Show left icon / Show right icon — Toggles leading and trailing icons.
• Left icon / Right icon — Swaps the corresponding icon.

2939:72.name: Type=Product
2939:72.description:
Description
Displays one or more Komerce product marks as compact cell content.


When to use
Use to show which products or services are associated with a table record.


Usage guidelines
Show only the products relevant to the record.
Keep the displayed set compact; move long lists to details or a tooltip.
Use product marks consistently and do not alter their artwork.


Properties
Show Affiliate, Show Komlabs, Show Raja Ongkir, Show Komads, Show Komcards, Show Komchat, Show Komclass, Show Kompack, Show Komplace, Show Komship, Show Komtim, Show Komed, Show Komstore, Show Komerce — Shows or hides each product mark.

2945:300.name: Type=Slot
2945:300.description:
Description
Provides a custom content slot for table-cell use cases not covered by the standard variants.


When to use
Use only when Text, Badge, Status, Action, Product, and the other predefined types cannot represent the required content.


Usage guidelines
Prefer a standard variant whenever possible.
Keep custom content within the cell bounds and aligned with neighboring rows.
Preserve table density, readability, and interaction conventions.


Properties
Slot — Replaces the placeholder with a custom component instance.
